_note: The mission. Chapters open in order. A goal is a pure check of the state; sustain = seconds the condition must hold without a break. Rewards arrive as a supply pod next to the lander (real units) plus research points. kind + params are evaluated by sim/goals.gd. See AAA_DESIGN §7.

chapters.name: Touchdown
chapters.desc: Make the base live before the lander air runs out.

goals.name: Power online
goals.desc: A generator and a battery on one network, with 2 E stored.
goals.hint: Solar array + battery, joined by a cable.

goals.name: Water flowing
goals.desc: 20 water in reservoirs.
goals.hint: Water extractor + reservoir on a powered network.

goals.name: First breath
goals.desc: A room of the base has its own oxygen.
goals.hint: Oxygen plant joined to rooms by corridors.

goals.name: Shelter
goals.desc: Every colonist has a bed in the base.
goals.hint: A habitat with air. The lander air ends on day 3.

chapters.name: Sustain
chapters.desc: Supply oxygen, water, food and power without help.

goals.name: O2 supply
goals.desc: Make at least 120% of the oxygen people breathe, for one full day.
goals.hint: More oxygen plants, or a bigger one.

goals.name: Water supply
goals.desc: Keep 1.5 days of drinking water, for one full day.
goals.hint: A second extractor or a bigger reservoir.

goals.name: Food supply
goals.desc: 2 days of cooked dishes in stock.
goals.hint: Greenhouses grow crops; the kitchen cooks them.

goals.name: Power supply
goals.desc: Pass one full night with no life-support structure switched off.
goals.hint: Enough batteries for the night, or wind turbines.

goals.name: Balanced diet
goals.desc: Average nutrition 55 or more over one full day.
goals.hint: Cook different dishes. Soy stew (kitchen level 2) gives protein and fat.

chapters.name: Industry
chapters.desc: Build the industry that the ship needs.

goals.name: Iron will
goals.desc: Refine 50 steel.
goals.hint: Mine on a deposit, then a refinery.

goals.name: Silicon age
goals.desc: Make 20 electronics.
goals.hint: Research Microelectronics. The fab needs silicate and steel.

goals.name: Science
goals.desc: Complete 3 research projects.
goals.hint: A research lab and a scientist.

goals.name: Growing settlement
goals.desc: 20 colonists.
goals.hint: Admit settlers when beds, air and food allow.

goals.name: Upgrade
goals.desc: Upgrade any structure to level 3.
goals.hint: Select a structure and use Upgrade.

goals.name: Survey the wreck
goals.desc: A colonist surveys the Meridian.
goals.hint: It is out of reach from far away: build an airlock near it.

goals.name: Patch the hull
goals.desc: Deliver 30 hull plates and 40 steel, then repair.
goals.hint: Hull plates come from a fabricator.

goals.name: Restore systems
goals.desc: Deliver 25 electronics and 10 glass, then repair.

goals.name: Fuel the engines
goals.desc: Deliver 40 rocket fuel and 10 composite, then repair.
goals.hint: Rocket fuel comes from a fuel refinery.

goals.name: Test flight
goals.desc: The Meridian flies.

chapters.name: Frontier
chapters.desc: Make the colony self-sufficient and keep the ship flying.

goals.name: Full supply
goals.desc: O2, water, food, balanced diet, power and spare parts, all at once, for 3 days.
goals.hint: Every supply bar green at the same time.

goals.name: Ship maintenance
goals.desc: Keep the Meridian's readiness at 80% or more for 5 days.
goals.hint: Maintenance uses rocket fuel and spare parts.

goals.name: Established colony
goals.desc: 50 colonists.

goals.name: Pinnacle
goals.desc: Any structure at level 5.
goals.hint: Level 5 needs special research and exotic crystals.

victory.name: Frontier established
victory.desc: Every chapter is complete. The colony stands on its own, and the Meridian flies. You can go on playing.
